verses.1: You, son of man, take for yourself a sharp razor, a barber's razor, and bring it on your head, on your beard. And take scales for weighing, and divide them.
verses.2: A third you shall burn in the middle of the city when the days of siege are fulfilled, and you shall take a third and strike it with the sword around it, and a third you shall scatter to the wind, and a sword I will sharpen after them.
verses.3: And you shall take from there a few in number, and bind them in your sash.
verses.4: And from those you shall take again and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From them fire will go out to all the house of Israel.
verses.5: Thus says the Lord YHWH: This is Jerusalem, in the midst of the nations I have placed her, and the surrounding lands.
verses.6: And you have despised my judgments for wickedness from the nations, and my statutes from the lands surrounding you, for you have rejected my judgments, and you have not walked in them.
verses.7: Therefore thus says the Lord YHWH: Because of your provocation from the nations surrounding you, and because you have not walked in my statutes, and have not done my judgments, but also have not walked in the judgments of the nations surrounding you,
verses.8: therefore thus says the Lord YHWH: Behold, I am against you, and I will do in your midst a judgment before the nations.
verses.9: And I will do in you what I have not done, and what I will not do again like it, for all your abominations.
verses.10: Therefore fathers will eat their children in your midst, and children will eat their fathers, and I will do in you judgments, and scatter all your survivors to every wind.
verses.11: Therefore I live, says the Lord YHWH, if it is not for the reason that you have defiled my sanctuary with all your abominations, I will remove you, my eye will not pity you, and I will not spare you.
verses.12: A third of you will die by plague within you, and a third will be consumed by famine within you, and a third I will scatter to every wind, and a sword I will draw after them.
verses.13: And My wrath will be completed, and My anger will rest upon them, and they will know that I am YHWH who have spoken in My jealousy, in completing My anger upon them.
verses.14: And I will make you a waste and a disgrace among the nations surrounding you in the sight of everyone passing by.
verses.15: And you will be a disgrace and a reproach, a lesson and a marvel to the nations surrounding you, in doing judgments upon you in My vengeance and My heat. I am YHWH who have spoken.
verses.16: In sending forth arrows of famine upon them, which are to destroy, which I will send to consume you, and famine will gather upon you, and I will break your staff of bread.
verses.17: And I will send upon you famine and wild beasts, and they will devour you, and plague and blood will pass through you, and I will bring a sword upon you. I am YHWH who have spoken.

notes:
Notes
- v. 2: The term "third" (שְׁלִשִׁית) is used three times in this verse. The translation follows the Hebrew, which divides the city into thirds for different fates.
- v. 12-13: The Greek version uses "fourth" (τέταρτον) in place of "third" (שְׁלִשִׁית), but the Hebrew is clear and consistent in using "third." The Greek is likely a textual error or alternate reading, so the Hebrew reading is followed.
